data.title: Artemis 128 budget colour and 5 MB office configurations

actions.description: Offer Artemis 128 KiB with two floppies, Color Monitor II 12-inch, keyboard, AIONix, Business Tools and one-year support. A second configuration adds a qualified 5 MB subsystem, external where necessary. Abacus 3 joins only from November 1980; networking follows May 1981. Preserve existing launch chronology.

Foresight secures capacity and component supply before projected orders. No supply rationing; production equals finite demand estimates, not infinite demand. Capital, inventory and support still cost money. In December 1982 promote both purpose-oriented budget configurations against Apple and the substitute-OS IBM offering.
